summary: Exited at +71.25pts after riding a strong favorable trend from entry through t=18m, where new leg highs kept forming with low giveback (0-15%) each time. The exit trigger was a sustained multi-detector against-confluence: KMDR-against, HA-against, and PROPP-against all fired together across two consecutive frames, coinciding with ER10 staying low (~0.26-0.32, choppy/non-trending) and a freshly-formed local leg already giving back 49% of its small amplitude. Next time I'd watch for this same 3-detector convergence earlier and weight it more than single-detector against-fires (which occurred repeatedly through the hold without being followed by real reversals), while also tracking ER10 decay as a confirming chop signal rather than acting on giveback% alone since giveback on the dominant leg had oscillated 0-22% throughout without ending the trend.
